external_policy: Company-owned websites (a registry-linked entity's own site: home page, sitemap-linked news/investor/careers/location/contact pages) are permitted by default per the official Signalpost source policy (docs/requirements/sources.md), which lists company-owned sources as preferred and does not require per-domain terms pre-review. Named third-party platforms in fetch.RESTRICTED (LinkedIn, Meta, Instagram, Indeed, Glassdoor, Google, Bing, YouTube, X/Twitter) remain hard-blocked pending licensed access. `domains` is an explicit override/denylist: an entry with access_allowed:false or retention_allowed:false blocks that specific domain even though it is not a restricted platform. Robots.txt, SSRF-safe DNS pinning, exact-entity identity gating and outbound budget limits remain enforced on every company-owned fetch.
